Before live deploy, production CI/CD, client delivery, or >1-dev: (1) Local AI checks .snowui/project.json; if unregistered, reads ~/.snowui/license.json, FIRST warns the user that publishing permanently consumes 1 non-revocable SnowUI project quota and waits for confirmation, then POSTs https://snowui.dev/api/account/agent/register-project with Bearer agentToken, verifies quota feedback, and writes productId to .snowui/project.json (if ~/.snowui/license.json is missing, stop and guide user to https://snowui.dev/account?section=projects or https://snowui.dev/pricing); (2) Web/online AI stops and guides user to register at https://snowui.dev/account?section=projects and paste back https://snowui.dev/api/license/ai-context/<id> to verify status=valid before proceeding.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Organize related content into expandable sections for FAQs, settings, and step-by-step explanations, with single or multiple sections open.

components.name: AccordionItem
components.description: Define one collapsible section within an Accordion, combining a heading and content under the parent expansion state.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Display a person or team avatar with image, text, and gradient fallbacks for lists, comments, and member details.

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.description: Arrange or stack multiple avatars and show the count of hidden members in team and collaborator lists.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Show unread counts and status with compact numbers, text, or dots alongside buttons, avatars, and navigation items.

components.name: BarChart
components.description: Compare categories with horizontal, vertical, grouped, or stacked bars, axes, and interactive details.
intents: adaptive monochrome contrast for chart foreground on light and dark surfaces

components.name: BlurText
components.description: Reveal headings and short passages letter by letter with blur, fade, and slight upward motion while preserving text layout.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: Show the current page hierarchy and provide paths back to parent pages.

components.name: Button
components.description: Trigger actions or navigation with text, icons, loading, and disabled states, from primary actions to compact tools.
components.whenToUse: Trigger immediate actions; use bare with emphasis="muted" when an unframed button needs opacity hover feedback.
components.avoidWhen: Use Segmented for mutually exclusive parameter selection; use Tab to switch content panels.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.description: Combine related buttons into one action group, with optional dividers for split buttons and compact toolbars.

components.name: Card
components.description: Present related content on a consistent card surface with flexible text, media, actions, fixed items, and scrolling.

components.name: ChartGroup
components.description: Coordinate multiple charts in one area with shared category hover, layered rendering, and aligned axes.
intents: adaptive monochrome contrast for chart foreground on light and dark surfaces

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Select independent options with checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states in forms or bulk selection.

components.name: Chip
components.description: Display a category, status, or short detail as a compact inline label alongside text, icons, and lists.

components.name: CircularChart
components.description: Show proportions as a ring or pie with segments, rounded ends, ring thickness, and hover emphasis.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.description: Display copyable code with syntax highlighting, line numbers, fullscreen viewing, and resizing.

components.name: ColorSchemeButton
components.description: Switch between light and dark themes with an icon that reflects the current scheme.

components.name: CopyButton
components.description: Copy text or code to the clipboard and briefly confirm success, useful for links, identifiers, and install commands.

components.name: CopyLink
components.description: Show a link that opens from its text and copies its address from the rest of the control.

components.name: DataTable
components.description: Coordinate querying, sorting, and pagination with composable toolbar, table, and pagination controls.
components.whenToUse: Display data lists requiring search, sorting, filtering, row selection, action columns, or pagination by composing TableToolbar, Table, and Pagination.
components.avoidWhen: Use Table when only semantic headers and data rows are needed.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Present focused content or actions in a modal with a backdrop, focus management, and background scroll lock.

components.name: ExpandButton
components.description: Switch between expanded and collapsed states with consistent button feedback.

components.name: Field
components.description: Combine an input, label, icon, and validation feedback into a consistent form field.

components.name: FlowText
components.description: Animate changes in text or numbers for dynamic copy, counters, timers, and countdowns.

components.name: Frame
components.description: Coordinate layout, state, loading, and motion across components through explicit configuration.

components.name: GaugeChart
components.description: Show several proportions in a semicircle or half pie with segments, gradients, ring thickness, and reveal motion.
components.whenToUse: Display multiple positive proportions in a semicircle or half-pie where the denominator is the sum of visible segments.
components.avoidWhen: No public single-metric min/max speedometer API is provided; use Progress for task completion percentages.

components.name: Gradient
components.description: Add soft layered gradients to backgrounds or placeholders with six palettes and scalable shape effects.

components.name: GradientMotion
components.description: Create a flowing gradient sweep for backgrounds, avatar placeholders, or clipped media areas.

components.name: Icon
components.description: Display SVG icons with consistent sizing and color in buttons, navigation, and content.

components.name: IconProvider
components.description: Replace SnowUI functional icons for an application or subtree while retaining defaults for unconfigured icons.

components.name: Image
components.description: Display images and placeholders with badges, actions, and preview entry points.

components.name: ImageGroup
components.description: Arrange multiple images with consistent sizes and group preview for galleries and attachments.

components.name: ImageViewer
components.description: Preview images or videos at page level with previous, next, and close controls.

components.name: Indicator
components.description: Provide a draggable resize handle for panels and content areas, with mouse and keyboard support.

components.name: Input
components.description: Provide single-line input for text, search, passwords, numbers, dates, times, and colors, with field feedback.

components.name: Kbd
components.description: Display shortcuts or keyboard hints as compact keycaps.

components.name: LineChart
components.description: Plot trends with multiple series, area fill, solid or dashed lines, axes, grids, and point styling.
intents: adaptive monochrome contrast for chart foreground on light and dark surfaces

components.name: Link
components.description: Provide clear text links in content, descriptions, and navigation, with optional directional indicators.

components.name: Listbox
components.description: Present selectable options in a popup with search filtering and keyboard support, including Select panels.

components.name: LocaleProvider
components.description: Set the language of built-in SnowUI interface messages for an application or subtree, with custom overrides.

components.name: MenuItem
components.description: Present an option in a list or quick-action menu with icon, selected, and disabled states.

components.name: MetricCard
components.description: Display one dashboard metric and an optional change; the application supplies the data and calculates comparisons.
components.whenToUse: Present a single KPI metric and optional period-over-period change.
components.avoidWhen: Use Card for general-purpose content containers.

components.name: NumberFlow
components.description: Animate changing numbers digit by digit with width transitions while preserving currency, grouping, and decimals.

components.name: NumericText
components.description: Animate only the changing portions of short text or numbers while preserving unchanged content.

components.name: OTPInput
components.description: Enter a configurable 4–8 digit one-time code with full-code paste, SMS autofill, and native form submission and reset.

components.name: OverflowAction
components.description: Define an action in OverflowActions that moves between a toolbar and its More menu as space changes.

components.name: OverflowActions
components.description: Keep actions accessible in limited space by moving those that do not fit into a More menu.
aliases: hide items one by one on narrow width
components.whenToUse: Collapse a row of actions to icon-only and move remaining items into a More menu when horizontal space shrinks.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Navigate between pages of tabular data, lists, or search results.

components.name: PasswordStrength
components.description: Evaluate password strength locally with a four-segment indicator and labels; the component does not persist, send, or submit passwords.
components.whenToUse: Evaluate and display local password strength across four segments.
components.avoidWhen: Use Progress for general task or upload completion.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Show supplementary content or actions near a trigger with size and trigger options.

components.name: Progress
components.description: Show determinate or indeterminate progress with a bar or circle for uploads, processing, and loading.

components.name: Radio
components.description: Choose one option from a mutually exclusive group when all choices should remain visible.

components.name: ScrambleText
components.description: Reveal a target heading, short sentence, or status through a progressive character scramble.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.description: Provide scrollable content with a consistent scrollbar for long lists, panels, and constrained spaces.

components.name: SearchBox
components.description: Open a search popup from a fully clickable search entry, optionally with a shortcut hint.

components.name: SearchInput
components.description: Provide a single-line search field with an icon for filtering lists, pages, and toolbar content.

components.name: SearchPopup
components.description: Compose a search panel with SearchInput and optional results, groups, and custom content; search logic and routing stay with the host.
components.whenToUse: Provide a unified search input, group headings, and result spacing as a composable block.
components.avoidWhen: Use Popover for generic floating surfaces; search ranking, history, and routing stay with the host.

components.name: Segmented
components.description: Switch quickly among a small set of exclusive filters or parameters, with keyboard and form support.
components.whenToUse: Select one option among mutually exclusive parameters or filters using radiogroup semantics.
components.avoidWhen: Use Tab when switching between distinct content panels.

components.name: Select
components.description: Choose from a dropdown built from data or custom options, with search and keyboard support.

components.name: SelectButton
components.description: Choose one dropdown option from a button, suited to toolbars and compact filters.

components.name: Separator
components.description: Separate content and actions horizontally or vertically to clarify information hierarchy.
components.avoidWhen: Do not use Separator for chart axis lines, grid lines, or breadcrumb paths.

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: Organize brand entry, grouped navigation, and footer actions with collapse and independent scrolling.

components.name: SidebarItem
components.description: Show a Sidebar navigation item with active state, icon, hierarchy, and status hints.

components.name: SidebarSection
components.description: Group Sidebar items under a heading with expand, collapse, and optional actions.

components.name: SidePanel
components.description: Show details or supporting content from the right in overlay or inline mode while retaining page context.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Show a placeholder outline while content loads, previewing structure and keeping layout stable.

components.name: Slider
components.description: Choose one value or a range by dragging, with horizontal, vertical, stepped, and filled styles.

components.name: SlotText
components.description: Animate text changes character by character with vertical rolls for short labels, status, and counters.

components.name: SnowUILogo
components.description: Display the SnowUI icon, wordmark, or combined mark in horizontal or vertical layouts.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Indicate ongoing loading with a rotating ring, spokes, or capsule shape.

components.name: StyleButton
components.description: Switch between SnowUI and Apple visual styles.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Toggle a setting or feature that takes effect immediately.

components.name: Tab
components.description: Switch between views or content panels, with generated or custom tabs and keyboard navigation.
components.whenToUse: Switch between distinct content panels or views.
components.avoidWhen: Use Segmented when changing a parameter or filter without switching panels.

components.name: Table
components.description: Display structured data in a semantic table with adaptive columns, local horizontal scrolling, and loading states.

components.name: TableBody
components.description: Group Table data rows while preserving table body semantics.

components.name: TableCell
components.description: Display text, components, or custom content in a Table cell, truncating long content by default.

components.name: TableHead
components.description: Define a Table column heading with optional sorting and resizing.

components.name: TableHeader
components.description: Group Table header rows and preserve native table header semantics.

components.name: TableRow
components.description: Group header or data cells into one row with consistent hover and interaction feedback.

components.name: TableToolbar
components.description: Add search, sort, filter, bulk actions, and selection status to DataTable.
intents: table search filter and bulk actions

components.name: Tag
components.description: Use an interactive label for markers, filters, or path segments.

components.name: Text
components.description: Render text with typography and truncation options for content, labels, and constrained areas.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Enter multi-line descriptions, notes, or longer content with native form attributes and field feedback.

components.name: ThemeButton
components.description: Switch between light and dark themes with an icon that reflects the current scheme.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Show brief feedback for results or status changes, with icons, actions, and rich content.

components.name: Toaster
components.description: Display global toast() notifications in six positions with stacking motion and a visible-item limit.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Show a short explanation on hover with collision handling and smooth switching.
